Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 14 May 1962^ after the drtm finalized by the Electrical Instru- 
ments and Meten Sectional Committee had been approved by the Elec- 
trotechnical Division Council. 

0.2 In the preparatioti of this standard, assistance has been derived from 
B.S. 1827: 1952 Reference Tables for Thermocouples ( Nickd/Chromium 
V Nickd/Aluminium )ittuedby the British Standards Institution. 

0.3 Reference tables for other thermocouple materials are given in the 
follo%nng Indian Standards: 

15:2055-1962 RjsfmRKNCB Tables for Platuium / Rkodiuii — 
Flatwuh THBmifocoupuis 

IS 4 2656^1%2 RifBRBNca Tablxs for Coppbr — Gonstantan 
Tksrmocouflii 

IS : 2057-1962 Rbvrrbmob Tablbs for Irou — GoMiTAifrAN 
Thermocouples 

(L4 The general requirements and tests applicable to the r moco u ple pyro- 
meters arc covered by *IS : 2053*1962 Specification for Thermocouple 
Pyrometers. 

1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard gives the reference tables of emf — temperature relation- 
ship for nickel/chpmium — nickd/aluminium thermocouples.

couple are given as follows:

3. TOLERANCES 

3*1 The calibration of the theimocouple shall agree with the values given 
in Tjible 1 and Table 2 within the following tolerances: 



Temperaturt Rangt^ ^C 

Oto 400 
Above 400 



Tolerances 
±3*C 



± 075 percent 

NoTB — It should be noted that these thermocouples nay be used on a 
temperature below 0"C. In these cases, the tolerance are usully the sinect of 
agreement between the manuiacturer and the user. Where the thermocouple b to 
be used below 0*C, the calibration on the boiling point of oxygen should be made.
